Metadata.title: BrightSmile Dental — Dental Clinic in Central Moscow
Metadata.description: English-speaking dentists in central Moscow, seven minutes from Chistye Prudy metro. Fillings, root canals, cleanings, implants, veneers and kids' dentistry, seven days a week. Book online and the consultation and 3D scan are free.

OgImage.title: A dentist you won't dread visiting
OgImage.subtitle: Dental clinic in central Moscow. We speak English and Russian
OgImage.badge: Free consultation when you book online

Hero.title: A dentist you won't dread visiting
Hero.subtitle: We see adults and kids. We numb the gum with gel before any injection, tell you the price before we start, and explain what we're doing as we go. Raise your hand at any point and we'll stop.
Hero.photoAlt: Smiling patient with her dentist at BrightSmile Dental
Hero.facts: We've been open {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} and have treated more than {patients} patients, with an average review score of {rating} out of 5. Open every day, until 4 PM on Sundays.

About.title: A small clinic where we know patients by name
About.text1: We have four dentists, and each one looks after their own patients from start to finish. We set aside a full hour for a first visit, so there's time for the exam, the scans and all your questions.
About.text2: Most people come to us on a friend's recommendation, and later bring their kids and parents. That's the best review we could ask for.

Advantages.title: Nobody looks forward to the dentist. We get it.
Advantages.subtitle: So we try to keep the visit calm and the bill free of surprises.

painless.title: Gel first, then the shot
painless.text: We numb the gum with gel before the injection, so you barely feel it. During treatment most people only notice some pressure.

equipment.title: Microscope and 3D scans
equipment.text: Root canals are done under a microscope. Before implants or complex work we take a 3D scan, so nothing is guesswork.

warranty.title: Up to {years}-year warranty
warranty.text: On implants, crowns and veneers. The terms are in your contract, and you can take it home to read before signing.

installments.title: Interest-free payment plans
installments.text: Treatment over ₽30,000 can be split into payments over up to 12 months. We also take DMS health insurance.

kids.title: A dentist just for kids
kids.text: Our pediatric dentist meets your child first, shows them the tools, and keeps visits short. We see kids from age three.

everyday.title: Open seven days
everyday.text: Monday to Saturday until 8 PM, Sundays until 4 PM. Easy to come in after work.

Advantages.photoAlt: A treatment room at BrightSmile Dental with the dental chair by the window

Doctors.title: Who'll be treating you
Doctors.subtitle: Each dentist has their own specialty. Whoever starts your treatment finishes it, so you won't be passed around.

Process.title: What happens after you book
Process.subtitle: You'll know the cost before treatment starts, not at the front desk.

request.title: Send a request
request.text: Fill in the form below or call us. Your name and phone number are enough.

call.title: We call you
call.text: During opening hours, the front desk calls back within 15 minutes to pick a day and a dentist.

consultation.title: Exam and plan
consultation.text: Your dentist checks your teeth, takes scans, and writes up a plan: what needs doing, in what order, and what each step costs.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.text: We stick to the plan you signed off on, then see you for a checkup every six months.

Offer.title: Free consultation and 3D scan
Offer.text: Your dentist examines you, takes a 3D scan and hands you a treatment plan with prices. Take it home and decide in your own time.
Offer.note: Usually ₽1,500 for the consultation and from ₽3,000 for the 3D scan
Offer.videoAlt: A short walk through the clinic: reception, corridor and a treatment room

Contacts.title: Finding us
Contacts.subtitle: In central Moscow, about a seven-minute walk from Chistye Prudy metro.

Footer.tagline: A dental clinic for adults and kids in central Moscow, near Chistye Prudy.

NotFound.title: That page doesn't exist
NotFound.text: The link may be old, or there's a typo in the address. Prices, dentists and booking are all on the home page.

Services.title: What treatment costs
Services.subtitle: Pick a category. Each service shows its starting price.
Services.note: Your dentist gives you the exact price after the exam, since it depends on what you actually need. You get the plan with prices before any work starts, and it doesn't change without your OK.

categoryText.therapy: Fillings, root canals and treating tooth pain. We do root canals under a microscope, which shows what the naked eye misses and saves more teeth.
categoryText.hygiene: We recommend a cleaning every six months. We remove tartar and stains, polish the enamel and show you the spots your brush misses.
categoryText.implants: Before any implant we take a 3D scan and walk you through the plan on screen. The surgeon places the implant and we make the crown in-house.
categoryText.orthodontics: We straighten teeth with clear aligners or braces. Your orthodontist shows you on a 3D model how your teeth will move before you start.
categoryText.aesthetics: Whitening, veneers and chip repair. We match color and shape so your teeth look natural, not uniformly white.
categoryText.kids: Our pediatric dentist sees children from age three. The first visit is about getting comfortable, and treatment is done in short sessions with breaks.

Kids.title: Children see their own dentist
Kids.text: Dr. Granina works only with kids. She takes her time and makes sure the visit feels interesting rather than scary.

firstVisit.title: First visit, no treatment.
firstVisit.text: Your child sits in the chair, holds the mirror, gets a checkup, and you get tips for brushing at home.

short.title: Short appointments.
short.text: Treatment takes 20 to 30 minutes, with breaks whenever your child needs one.

parent.title: You can stay.
parent.text: Parents are welcome in the room for the whole visit.

Kids.photoAlt: A pediatric dentist talking to a little girl in the dental chair

Results.title: Work by our dentists
Results.subtitle: Drag the slider to compare how things looked before and after treatment.

Reviews.subtitle: Average rating: {rating} out of 5. Here's what people say after their visits.

Faq.title: Questions people ask us
Faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Call us or message us on Telegram. The front desk will answer or check with a dentist.

Privacy.metaDescription: How BrightSmile Dental processes and protects personal data under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ.
Privacy.title: Personal Data Policy
Privacy.intro: This Policy is issued under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data” of 27 July 2006. It explains, in plain language, what information we receive through our website, why we need it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Your personal data is controlled by {legalName}{legalDetails}, {address}. For any privacy questions, email {email} or call {phone}.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
paragraphs: Only what you enter in the booking form: your name and phone number and, if you choose, a service, a dentist, a preferred date and time, and a comment.
We don't ask for health information through the website. Please don't include it in the comment field — your dentist will go over everything at your visit.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
paragraphs: To call you back, schedule your visit and answer your questions. We don't use your details for marketing, and we never sell them.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: Your consent to the processing of personal data (Art. 6(1)(1) of Law No. 152-FZ), which you give by ticking the consent box in the booking form.

sections.title: 5. How we process it
paragraphs: We collect, record, organize, store, update, use, transfer, block, delete and destroy data, both with and without automated tools.

sections.title: 6. Transfer and storage
paragraphs: Your request is delivered to our front desk team via Telegram, and the website is hosted on Vercel. These services may keep data on servers outside Russia, so by sending the form you agree to this cross-border transfer.
We don't share your data with anyone else unless Russian law requires it.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your data only as long as needed for the purposes above, and no longer than 12 months after your request or until you withdraw consent, whichever comes first. After that it is deleted.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask how your data is processed, have it corrected, blocked or destroyed, and file a complaint with Roskomnadzor (the Russian data protection authority) or a court.
Send requests to {email}. We reply within 10 business days, or up to 5 more business days if we tell you why we need extra time.

sections.title: 9. Withdrawing consent
paragraphs: You can withdraw your consent at any time by emailing {email} with the subject “Withdraw consent”. We'll stop processing and destroy your data within 30 days.

sections.title: 10. Security
paragraphs: Only staff who handle scheduling can see booking requests. We take the legal, organizational and technical measures required to protect your data from unauthorized access.

sections.title: 11. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: We don't use advertising cookies or web analytics. The Contact section includes an embedded Google Map; when it loads, Google may set its own cookies under its own policy.

sections.title: 12. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy. The current version is always posted on this page with its effective date.
